Oven Bbq Ribs
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:49am

Ingredients




2 lbs. pork side ribs or beef
1 cup ketchup
1/4 cup vinegar
1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce
1/4 cup onion, chopped
1 clove garlic, crushed
2 tablespoons brown sugar
1 tablespoon paprika
2 teaspoons dry mustard
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper





Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Bake ribs in roaster for 1 hour to get rid of some of the fat. Combine sauce ingredients while ribs are baking. Drain fat from ribs. Pour sauce over ribs. Bake another hour, basting 2 or 3 times.
